facts.detail: The page is an official-statistics announcement for BDUK delivery performance.
The announced statistical period is April 2026 to June 2026.
The planned release concerns UK premises receiving gigabit-capable coverage as a result of BDUK subsidy.
The announcement is published by Building Digital UK and the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology.
The announcement was published on 23 June 2026.
The announcement was last updated on 23 June 2026.
The provisional release month is August 2026.
The page states that the statistics will be released in August 2026.
No candidate is promoted from an announcement before the underlying statistics are released and validated.

facts.detail: The performance report covers 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025.
BDUK's mission is access to fast and reliable digital connectivity for UK homes and businesses.
BDUK is responsible for gigabit broadband rollout and mobile expansion in hard-to-reach areas.
BDUK is part of the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology.
The report identifies Project Gigabit and the Shared Rural Network as BDUK's two major programmes.
Project Gigabit supports the ambition for nationwide gigabit broadband coverage by 2032.
The Shared Rural Network aims for more than 95% of UK landmass to have 4G from at least one operator.
The 2025 Spending Review provided £1.9 billion capital investment up to 2029-30 for Project Gigabit and SRN.
Project Gigabit continues to target 99% gigabit coverage across the UK.
The national target date was revised from 2030 to 2032.
